formation: Depicts a person standing on the ground (𡈼) in front of a corner of a courtyard (𠃊). Based on the original meaning "courtyard", now written as 庭.

components.note: Depicts the corner of a courtyard or a curved ground. Modern form looks like 廴.
Depicts a person (亻) standing on the ground (土). 𡈼 also represents the sound.
